def _build_sync_diff(
    source_abs,
    target_abs,
    src_heads,
    src_records,
    tgt_heads,
    tgt_records,
    target_digest,
):
    """Freeze the two family snapshots into the incremental artifact.

    Blocks are appended in manifest member order and segment position
    order, so the artifact is a deterministic pure function of the two
    snapshots.  A slot the corresponding target member reaches through
    identical bytes is recorded in ``"sh"`` and carries no block; every
    other source slot references one carried block.
    """
    blocks = []  # (segment name, raw bytes)
    manifest_members = []
    for position, directory in enumerate(source_abs):
        target_directory = target_abs[position]
        head = src_heads[directory]
        target_head = tgt_heads[target_directory]
        member_records = src_records[directory]
        target_member_records = tgt_records[target_directory]
        reach = []
        shared = []
        for index in range(head + 1):
            name = _segment_name(index)
            raw = member_records[name][0]
            shared_here = (
                index <= target_head
                and target_member_records[name][0] == raw
            )
            if shared_here:
                shared.append(index)
            else:
                reach.append(len(blocks))
                blocks.append((name, raw))
        manifest_members.append(
            {
                "name": os.path.basename(directory),
                "head": head,
                "segments": reach,
                "sh": shared,
            }
        )
    manifest = {
        "v": _SYNC_EXPORT_VERSION,
        "target": target_digest,
        "members": manifest_members,
        "segments": [
            {"name": name, "size": len(raw), "crc": zlib.crc32(raw) & 0xFFFFFFFF}
            for name, raw in blocks
        ],
    }
    return _frame_family_like_artifact(
        SYNC_EXPORT_MAGIC, manifest, [raw for _name, raw in blocks]
    )


def _frame_family_like_artifact(magic, manifest, blobs):
    """Frame a family-style artifact (full or sync); the sync share slot."""
    manifest_bytes = json.dumps(
        manifest, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True
    ).encode("utf-8")
    end_magic = magic + b"END"
    body = bytearray()
    body += magic
    body += struct.pack("<I", manifest["v"])
    body += struct.pack("<Q", len(manifest_bytes))
    body += manifest_bytes
    body += struct.pack("<Q", len(blobs))
    crc = zlib.crc32(manifest_bytes)
    for raw in blobs:
        body += struct.pack("<Q", len(raw))
        body += raw
        crc = zlib.crc32(raw, crc)
    body += end_magic
    body += struct.pack("<I", crc & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    return bytes(body)


def _read_artifact_envelope(raw, magic, what):
    """Validate the common envelope of a family-style artifact.

    Returns ``(version, manifest_bytes, manifest, blobs)`` with every
    block already length- and CRC-checked; *blobs* is the ordered list of
    block bytes.  Any framing, truncation or CRC defect rejects the whole
    artifact with :class:`CheckpointError`.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} must be bytes")
    data = bytes(raw)
    end_magic = magic + b"END"
    prefix_len = len(magic) + 4 + 8
    if len(data) < prefix_len:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} is truncated while reading its header")
    if data[: len(magic)] != magic:
        raise CheckpointError(f"not a {what} (bad magic)")
    (version,) = struct.unpack("<I", data[len(magic) : len(magic) + 4])
    (manifest_len,) = struct.unpack("<Q", data[len(magic) + 4 : prefix_len])
    if manifest_len <= 0:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} manifest length is invalid")
    trailer_len = len(end_magic) + 4
    trailer_pos = data.rfind(end_magic)
    if trailer_pos < 0 or len(data) - trailer_pos != trailer_len:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} trailer is missing or the file is torn")
    manifest_start = prefix_len
    if manifest_len > trailer_pos - manifest_start:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} manifest overruns the block area")
    manifest_bytes = data[manifest_start : manifest_start + manifest_len]
    (stored_crc,) = struct.unpack(
        "<I", data[trailer_pos + len(end_magic) :]
    )
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} manifest is invalid: {exc}") from exc
    block_count_pos = manifest_start + manifest_len
    if block_count_pos + 8 > trailer_pos:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} is truncated before its block inventory")
    (block_count,) = struct.unpack(
        "<Q", data[block_count_pos : block_count_pos + 8]
    )
    segment_inventory = manifest.get("segments")
    if not isinstance(segment_inventory, list):
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} segment inventory is invalid")
    if block_count != len(segment_inventory):
        raise CheckpointError(
            f"{what} block count does not match its segment inventory"
        )
    pos = block_count_pos + 8
    blobs = []
    running_crc = zlib.crc32(manifest_bytes)
    for block_id, entry in enumerate(segment_inventory):
        _exact_keys(entry, _FAMILY_SEGMENT_KEYS, f"{what} segment entry {block_id}")
        name = entry["name"]
        if not isinstance(name, str) or _segment_index(name) is None:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment entry {block_id} has a bad segment file name"
            )
        size = entry["size"]
        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size <= 0:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment entry {block_id} ({name}) has an invalid size"
            )
        crc_value = entry["crc"]
        if (
            isinstance(crc_value, bool)
            or not isinstance(crc_value, int)
            or not 0 <= crc_value <= 0xFFFFFFFF
        ):
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment entry {block_id} ({name}) has an invalid crc"
            )
        if pos + 8 > trailer_pos:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} is truncated before segment block {block_id} ({name})"
            )
        (raw_len,) = struct.unpack("<Q", data[pos : pos + 8])
        pos += 8
        if raw_len != size or size > trailer_pos - pos:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment block {block_id} ({name}) is truncated or its "
                "length disagrees with the manifest"
            )
        chunk = data[pos : pos + size]
        pos += size
        if (zlib.crc32(chunk) & 0xFFFFFFFF) != crc_value:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment block {block_id} ({name}) fails its CRC"
            )
        running_crc = zlib.crc32(chunk, running_crc)
        blobs.append(chunk)
    if pos != trailer_pos:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} has trailing or misaligned block bytes")
    if (running_crc & 0xFFFFFFFF) != stored_crc:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} CRC mismatch: the file is corrupt or torn")
    return version, manifest_bytes, manifest, blobs


def _parse_sync_artifact(raw):
    """Validate and decode a sync artifact.

    Returns ``(target_digest, members, blobs)`` where *members* is the
    validated per-member plan (``{"name", "head", "blocks", "shared"}``)
    and *blobs* the carried segment blocks in inventory order.  The whole
    artifact -- envelope, manifest structure, every block's CRC, the
    per-member reach layout (blocks and shared positions partition
    ``0..head`` with a block at every non-shared slot), every carried
    segment frame walked exactly like a load and the members'
    shape/layer-order agreement -- is checked before anything is
    returned; any defect rejects the whole artifact with ``ValueError``.
    """
    version, _manifest_bytes, manifest, blobs = _read_artifact_envelope(
        raw, SYNC_EXPORT_MAGIC, "family sync artifact"
    )
    if version != _SYNC_EXPORT_VERSION:
        raise CheckpointError(
            f"unsupported family sync artifact version {version}; this build "
            f"reads version {_SYNC_EXPORT_VERSION}"
        )
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or set(manifest) != _SYNC_MANIFEST_KEYS:
        raise CheckpointError(
            "family sync artifact manifest must be an object with exactly "
            f"the fields {sorted(_SYNC_MANIFEST_KEYS)}"
        )
    if (
        not isinstance(manifest["v"], int)
        or isinstance(manifest["v"], bool)
        or manifest["v"] != version
    ):
        raise CheckpointError("family sync artifact manifest version mismatch")
    target_digest = manifest["target"]
    if not isinstance(target_digest, str) or not re.fullmatch(
        r"[0-9a-f]{64}", target_digest
    ):
        raise CheckpointError("family sync artifact target digest is invalid")
    members_raw = manifest["members"]
    if not isinstance(members_raw, list) or not members_raw:
        raise CheckpointError("family sync artifact must name at least one member")
    members = []
    seen_names = set()
    used_blocks = set()
    for position, entry in enumerate(members_raw):
        what = f"family sync artifact member {position}"
        _exact_keys(entry, _SYNC_MEMBER_KEYS, what)
        name = entry["name"]
        _check_family_member_name(name, what)
        if name in seen_names:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact lists member {name!r} more than once"
            )
        seen_names.add(name)
        head = entry["head"]
        if isinstance(head, bool) or not isinstance(head, int) or head < 0:
            raise CheckpointError(f"{what} ({name!r}) has an invalid head")
        block_refs = entry["segments"]
        shared = entry["sh"]
        if not isinstance(block_refs, list) or not isinstance(shared, list):
            raise CheckpointError(f"{what} ({name!r}) has invalid segment lists")
        blocks_at = {}
        previous = -1
        for slot, block_id in enumerate(block_refs):
            if (
                isinstance(block_id, bool)
                or not isinstance(block_id, int)
                or not 0 <= block_id < len(blobs)
            ):
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) names no segment block at entry {slot}"
                )
            if block_id <= previous:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) lists its blocks out of order"
                )
            previous = block_id
            blocks_at[block_id] = len(blocks_at)
            used_blocks.add(block_id)
        shared_positions = []
        previous_pos = -1
        for slot_index in shared:
            if (
                isinstance(slot_index, bool)
                or not isinstance(slot_index, int)
                or not 0 <= slot_index <= head
            ):
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) names an invalid shared position"
                )
            if slot_index <= previous_pos:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) lists shared positions out of order"
                )
            previous_pos = slot_index
            shared_positions.append(slot_index)
        if len(block_refs) + len(shared_positions) != head + 1:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} ({name!r}) must name one block or shared slot for "
                "every segment position 0..head"
            )
        if set(block_refs) and len(set(block_refs)) != len(block_refs):
            raise CheckpointError(f"{what} ({name!r}) references a block twice")
        members.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "head": head,
                "block_refs": list(block_refs),
                "shared": shared_positions,
            }
        )
    if used_blocks != set(range(len(blobs))):
        raise CheckpointError(
            "family sync artifact carries a segment block no member reaches"
        )
    _validate_sync_chains(members, blobs)
    return target_digest, members, blobs


def _member_slot_bytes(member, slot, blobs, shared_loader=None):
    """The segment bytes a sync plan places one member at position *slot*.

    Carried blocks come from the artifact; a shared slot is resolved
    through *shared_loader* (the target family the artifact is applied
    against or converted with).
    """
    if slot in member["_shared_set"]:
        if shared_loader is None:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact member {member['name']!r} has a shared "
                "slot but no target family to resolve it"
            )
        return shared_loader(member, slot)
    carried = member["_carried_map"].get(slot)
    if carried is None:
        raise CheckpointError(
            f"family sync artifact member {member['name']!r} names no segment "
            f"at position {slot}"
        )
    return blobs[carried]


def _prepare_sync_maps(members):
    """Attach fast slot->block / shared-slot maps to each plan member."""
    for member in members:
        shared_set = set(member["shared"])
        carried_map = {}
        block_index = 0
        for slot in range(member["head"] + 1):
            if slot not in shared_set:
                carried_map[slot] = member["block_refs"][block_index]
                block_index += 1
        member["_shared_set"] = shared_set
        member["_carried_map"] = carried_map


def _validate_sync_chains(members, blobs):
    """Walk every member's assembled chain like a load; check shape agreement.

    Shared slots cannot be validated from the artifact alone (they carry
    no bytes), so this walks the carried chain backbone: the first
    non-shared slot must be the basis and the carried slots after it
    must form a valid delta chain in slot order.  The shared prefix is
    matched byte for byte against the target at apply and conversion
    time, where a defect is reported then.
    """
    _prepare_sync_maps(members)
    documents = []
    for position, member in enumerate(members):
        head = member["head"]
        carried_slots = sorted(member["_carried_map"])
        if not carried_slots or 0 in member["_shared_set"]:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact member {position} ({member['name']!r}) "
                "is invalid: it carries no basis block"
            )
        try:
            first = carried_slots[0]
            walker = _ChainWalker(blobs[member["_carried_map"][first]])
            expected_number = first
            if first != 0:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    "the first carried segment must be the basis at "
                    "position 0"
                )
            for slot in carried_slots[1:]:
                walker.apply_delta(
                    slot, blobs[member["_carried_map"][slot]]
                )
            document = walker.document()
        except CheckpointError as exc:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact member {position} ({member['name']!r}) "
                f"is invalid: {exc}"
            ) from exc
        documents.append(document)
    _check_family_shape_agreement(
        documents, [member["name"] for member in members], "family sync"
    )


def apply_family_diff(artifact, target):
    """Apply a family sync artifact to the target family atomically.

    *artifact* is a sync artifact file produced by :func:`diff_families`;
    *target* is the existing parent directory holding the target
    family's member directories.  The artifact is read and validated in
    full, and the target family matched against the digest recorded,
    before anything is written.  Each member's resulting chain is then
    populated inside a private staging directory -- positions the target
    already holds byte for byte are hard-linked (the shared history
    stays one physical copy), carried blocks written whole, and the
    ``head`` pointer committed last -- and the member directories are
    renamed into place only once the whole family is staged, so the
    apply either lands for every member or for none.

    After it lands, every target member's parameters, gradients,
    optimizer state and step count and hidden state are bit for bit the
    source family's; no optimizer step advances.  Applying the same
    artifact to the family it already produced is a no-op.  A process
    killed mid-apply leaves a resumable marker plus whole-file staging
    debris: re-running the same apply finishes the family with a result
    bit for bit identical to one uninterrupted run, and the debris is
    reclaimed deterministically by the next family operation over the
    target directory.

    A missing artifact file or target directory, or a member directory
    the application needs, raises ``FileNotFoundError`` without touching
    the other side.  A torn, truncated, missing-field or reordered
    artifact, a shape/layer-order mismatch, or an artifact that does not
    match the target family rejects the whole apply with ``ValueError``
    before one byte of the target is rewritten.  An unwritable directory
    or a full disk raises ``OSError``; an interrupted application leaves
    only whole files in staging, never a half-written segment.
    """
    if not isinstance(artifact, (str, os.PathLike)):
        raise TypeError("sync artifact must be a filesystem path")
    if not isinstance(target, (str, os.PathLike)):
        raise TypeError("sync target must be a directory path")
    artifact = os.fspath(artifact)
    target = os.fspath(target)
    with open(artifact, "rb") as fh:
        raw = fh.read()
    target_digest, plan, blobs = _parse_sync_artifact(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if not os.path.exists(target):
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"family sync target directory not found: {target!r}"
        )
    if not os.path.isdir(target):
        raise CheckpointError(f"family sync target is not a directory: {target!r}")
    parent = os.path.abspath(target)
    with _FamilyParentGuard(parent):
        _family_register(parent)
        try:
            _sweep_parent_staging(parent)
            target_paths = _sync_target_paths(parent, plan)
            target_heads, target_records, target_documents = (
                _sync_capture_target(target_paths)
            )
            actual_digest = _family_target_digest(
                target_paths, target_heads, target_records
            )
            already = actual_digest == target_digest and _sync_members_match_plan(
                parent, plan, blobs, target_paths, target_heads, target_records
            )
            marker = _read_sync_marker(parent)
            if already:
                _unlink_quietly(os.path.join(parent, _SYNC_MARKER_NAME))
                _fsync_directory(parent)
                return None
            if actual_digest != target_digest:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    "family sync artifact does not match the target family: "
                    "the target family has changed since the diff was "
                    "produced (its member-reachable state differs from the "
                    "digest recorded in the artifact)"
                )
            _validate_sync_against_target(
                plan, blobs, target_paths, target_heads, target_records
            )
            if marker is not None and marker["d"] == digest:
                pass  # resume: staging directories already present
            elif marker is not None:
                _unlink_quietly(os.path.join(parent, _SYNC_MARKER_NAME))
            _atomic_write(
                parent, _SYNC_MARKER_NAME, _encode_sync_marker(digest)
            )
            for member in plan:
                _commit_sync_member(parent, member, blobs, target_paths)
            for member in plan:
                final = os.path.join(parent, member["name"])
                staging = _sync_staging_path(parent, member["name"])
                if os.path.isdir(staging) and os.path.isdir(final):
                    _publish_sync_member(parent, member)
            _unlink_quietly(os.path.join(parent, _SYNC_MARKER_NAME))
            _sweep_parent_staging(parent)
            _fsync_directory(parent)
        finally:
            _family_release(parent)
    return None


def _sync_target_paths(parent, plan):
    """The existing target member directories in plan order.

    Every planned member must currently exist as a chain directory; a
    missing one is a missing referenced family member and raises
    ``FileNotFoundError`` (the target is left untouched).
    """
    paths = []
    for member in plan:
        path = os.path.join(parent, member["name"])
        if not os.path.isdir(path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                "family sync target member directory not found: " f"{path!r}"
            )
        paths.append(path)
    return paths


def _sync_capture_target(target_paths):
    """One quiescent snapshot of the target family for matching."""
    ordered = sorted(target_paths)
    while True:
        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            for directory in ordered:
                stack.enter_context(_DirectoryChainLock(directory))
            stores = {d: _DirectoryChainStore(d) for d in ordered}
            for directory, store in stores.items():
                _recover_directory_chain(directory, store)
            busy = [d for d in ordered if _member_fold_busy(d)]
            if not busy:
                heads = {}
                records = {}
                documents = {}
                for directory, store in stores.items():
                    head = _read_head_optional(store)
                    if head is None:
                        raise CheckpointError(
                            "chain has no head pointer (no basis segment "
                            f"committed): {directory!r}"
                        )
                    heads[directory] = head
                    records[directory], documents[directory] = (
                        _read_member_segments(directory, store, head)
                    )
                return heads, records, documents
        for directory in busy:
            _wait_for_member_quiescent(directory)


def _sync_members_match_plan(
    parent, plan, blobs, target_paths, target_heads, target_records
):
    """Whether each target member already equals the artifact's end state.

    The target digest already pins every member's current reachable
    bytes; this additionally requires the target to carry exactly the
    artifact's head per member (the digest comparison above implies it,
    but the explicit check keeps the no-op test independent of digest
    internals).  Pure read-only.
    """
    for member, path in zip(plan, target_paths):
        if target_heads[path] != member["head"]:
            return False
    return True


def _validate_sync_against_target(
    plan, blobs, target_paths, target_heads, target_records
):
    """Check every shared slot resolves to identical target bytes.

    Runs before anything is written.  A shared position must exist in
    the target member and carry byte-for-byte the block the source
    chain's continuity requires; the carried backbone is already fully
    validated by :func:`_parse_sync_artifact`.  This also verifies the
    assembled source state agrees with the target model's shapes and
    layer order.
    """
    documents = []
    for member, path in zip(plan, target_paths):
        head = member["head"]
        target_head = target_heads[path]
        records = target_records[path]
        for slot in member["shared"]:
            if slot > target_head:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"family sync artifact member {member['name']!r} marks "
                    f"segment {slot} shared but the target head is "
                    f"{target_head}"
                )
            target_name = _segment_name(slot)
            if target_name not in records:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"family sync target member {member['name']!r} is missing "
                    f"the shared segment {target_name}"
                )
        walker = None
        for slot in range(head + 1):
            name = _segment_name(slot)
            if slot in member["_shared_set"]:
                raw = records[name][0]
            else:
                raw = blobs[member["_carried_map"][slot]]
            if slot == 0:
                walker = _ChainWalker(raw)
            else:
                walker.apply_delta(slot, raw)
        documents.append(walker.document())
    _check_family_shape_agreement(
        documents, [member["name"] for member in plan], "family sync"
    )


def _sync_staging_path(parent, name):
    return os.path.join(parent, _SYNC_STAGING_PREFIX + name)


def _commit_sync_member(parent, member, blobs, target_paths):
    """Populate one member's staging chain; skip one already complete.

    Shared slots are hard-linked from the live target member (the bytes
    are byte-for-byte pinned by validation), carried blocks are written
    whole as regular files, and the ``head`` pointer is committed last,
    exactly the fork commit order.  A staging directory already holding
    the complete chain (a resume) is left as is.
    """
    name = member["name"]
    target_dir = os.path.join(parent, name)
    staging = _sync_staging_path(parent, name)
    if os.path.isdir(staging) and _sync_staging_complete(staging, member, blobs):
        return
    if os.path.isdir(staging):
        _remove_tree_quietly(staging)
    lease_fd = None
    committed = False
    try:
        with _DirectoryChainLock(parent):
            os.mkdir(staging)
            _fork_staging_register(staging)
            lease_fd = _acquire_staging_lease(staging)
        for slot in range(member["head"] + 1):
            slot_name = _segment_name(slot)
            if slot in member["_shared_set"]:
                os.link(os.path.join(target_dir, slot_name),
                        os.path.join(staging, slot_name))
            else:
                _atomic_write(
                    staging, slot_name, blobs[member["_carried_map"][slot]]
                )
        _atomic_write(staging, _HEAD_NAME, str(member["head"]).encode("ascii"))
        _fsync_directory(staging)
        committed = True
    finally:
        if staging is not None:
            _release_staging_lease(lease_fd, staging)
        if not committed and os.path.isdir(staging):
            _remove_tree_quietly(staging)


def _sync_staging_complete(staging, member, blobs):
    """Whether a staging dir already holds this member's full chain."""
    try:
        with open(os.path.join(staging, _HEAD_NAME), "rb") as fh:
            if fh.read() != str(member["head"]).encode("ascii"):
                return False
        for slot in range(member["head"] + 1):
            if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(staging, _segment_name(slot))):
                return False
    except OSError:
        return False
    return True


def _publish_sync_member(parent, member):
    """Swap one fully staged member into its final place atomically.

    The live member is renamed aside to a sync-detached name and the
    staging renamed over it in one directory-entry change each; the
    detached old chain is emptied afterwards.  Its shared slots are
    hard links, so removing the old directory releases only the target's
    own references and reclaims a segment's bytes exactly when the new
    chain no longer reaches them either.
    """
    name = member["name"]
    final = os.path.join(parent, name)
    staging = _sync_staging_path(parent, name)
    detached = os.path.join(
        parent, _DELETE_TMP_PREFIX + _SYNC_STAGING_PREFIX + name + "-"
    )
    # A resume may already have published: staging gone, final in place.
    if not os.path.isdir(staging):
        return
    with _DirectoryChainLock(parent):
        if os.path.exists(detached):
            _remove_tree_quietly(detached)
        os.rename(final, detached)
        os.rename(staging, final)
        _fsync_directory(parent)
    _empty_and_remove(detached)
    _unlink_quietly(os.path.join(final, _STAGING_LOCK_NAME))
    _fsync_directory(parent)


def _encode_sync_marker(digest):
    return json.dumps(
        {"v": 1, "d": digest}, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")
    ).encode("ascii")


def _read_sync_marker(parent):
    """The interrupted-apply marker in *parent*, or None when unusable."""
    path = os.path.join(parent, _SYNC_MARKER_NAME)
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as fh:
            marker = json.loads(fh.read().decode("ascii"))
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return None
    if not isinstance(marker, dict) or set(marker) != _SYNC_MARKER_KEYS:
        return None
    if marker["v"] != 1 or not isinstance(marker["d"], str):
        return None
    return marker


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Full <-> incremental artifact conversion
#
# The conversion is a pure function of the artifacts: a full family
# artifact (``SEQFAMX1``) is converted to the incremental form against
# the target family it would be applied to, and a sync artifact is
# converted to the self-contained full form by materializing its shared
# slots from that same target.  A family imported after either
# conversion loads, member by member, to exactly the same state the
# other form produces.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _full_artifact_plan_and_blobs(raw):
    """Parse a full family artifact; return ``(members, blobs)``."""
    return _parse_family_export(raw)


def full_to_incremental_artifact(full_artifact, target_members):
    """Convert a full family artifact to a sync artifact against *target*.

    *full_artifact* is the bytes of a full family artifact
    (``SEQFAMX1``); *target_members* is the target family (a sequence of
    chain directories) the resulting sync artifact would be applied to,
    aligned with the artifact's member order.  The target is read only.
    Slots the target already holds byte for byte become shared (no
    stored block); every other block of the full artifact is carried.
    The state a family imported from the converted artifact lands is bit
    for bit the state the full artifact restores.
    """
    if isinstance(full_artifact, (str, os.PathLike)):
        with open(os.fspath(full_artifact), "rb") as fh:
            full_artifact = fh.read()
    plan, blobs = _full_artifact_plan_and_blobs(full_artifact)
    target_paths = _normalize_family_members(
        target_members, "a sync target family"
    )
    for path in target_paths:
        if not os.path.isdir(path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"incremental checkpoint directory not found: {path!r}"
            )
    target_abs = [os.path.abspath(path) for path in target_paths]
    if len(target_abs) != len(plan):
        raise CheckpointError(
            "the full artifact and the target family must have the same "
            f"member count ({len(plan)} vs {len(target_abs)})"
        )
    target_parent = _one_parent(target_abs, "a family sync conversion")
    _sweep_parent_staging(target_parent)
    with _FamilyParentGuard(target_parent):
        heads, records, documents = _sync_capture_target(target_abs)
    return _sync_artifact_from_full_plan(plan, blobs, target_abs, heads, records)


def _sync_artifact_from_full_plan(plan, blobs, target_abs, heads, records):
    """Shared builder for the file and memory full -> sync conversions."""
    target_digest = _family_target_digest(target_abs, heads, records)
    out_blocks = []
    manifest_members = []
    for position, member in enumerate(plan):
        target_records = records[target_abs[position]]
        target_head = heads[target_abs[position]]
        reach = []
        shared = []
        for slot, block_id in enumerate(member["segments"]):
            raw = blobs[block_id]
            name = _segment_name(slot)
            if slot <= target_head and target_records[name][0] == raw:
                shared.append(slot)
            else:
                reach.append(len(out_blocks))
                out_blocks.append((name, raw))
        manifest_members.append(
            {
                "name": member["name"],
                "head": member["head"],
                "segments": reach,
                "sh": shared,
            }
        )
    manifest = {
        "v": _SYNC_EXPORT_VERSION,
        "target": target_digest,
        "members": manifest_members,
        "segments": [
            {"name": name, "size": len(raw), "crc": zlib.crc32(raw) & 0xFFFFFFFF}
            for name, raw in out_blocks
        ],
    }
    return _frame_family_like_artifact(
        SYNC_EXPORT_MAGIC, manifest, [raw for _name, raw in out_blocks]
    )


def incremental_to_full_artifact(sync_artifact, target_members):
    """Convert a sync artifact to a self-contained full family artifact.

    *sync_artifact* is the bytes of a sync artifact (``SEQFAMX2``);
    *target_members* is the target family (a sequence of chain
    directories) the artifact was diffed against, aligned with its
    member order.  Every shared slot is materialized from the target and
    stored as a regular block, so the returned artifact is fully
    self-contained; importing either artifact lands bit-for-bit the same
    member states.  The target family is only read.  A sync artifact
    that does not match the target family raises ``ValueError``.
    """
    if isinstance(sync_artifact, (str, os.PathLike)):
        with open(os.fspath(sync_artifact), "rb") as fh:
            sync_artifact = fh.read()
    target_digest, plan, blobs = _parse_sync_artifact(sync_artifact)
    target_paths = _normalize_family_members(
        target_members, "a sync target family"
    )
    for path in target_paths:
        if not os.path.isdir(path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                f"incremental checkpoint directory not found: {path!r}"
            )
    target_abs = [os.path.abspath(path) for path in target_paths]
    if len(target_abs) != len(plan):
        raise CheckpointError(
            "the sync artifact and the target family must have the same "
            f"member count ({len(plan)} vs {len(target_abs)})"
        )
    target_parent = _one_parent(target_abs, "a family sync conversion")
    _sweep_parent_staging(target_parent)
    with _FamilyParentGuard(target_parent):
        heads, records, documents = _sync_capture_target(target_abs)
        actual = _family_target_digest(target_abs, heads, records)
        if actual != target_digest:
            raise CheckpointError(
                "the sync artifact does not match the given target family "
                "(its member-reachable state differs from the digest "
                "recorded in the artifact)"
            )
        return _full_artifact_from_sync_plan(plan, blobs, target_abs, records)


def _full_artifact_from_sync_plan(plan, blobs, target_abs, records):
    """Shared builder for the file and memory sync -> full conversions."""
    out_blocks = []
    block_of_key = {}
    manifest_members = []
    for position, member in enumerate(plan):
        target_records = records[target_abs[position]]
        reach = []
        for slot in range(member["head"] + 1):
            name = _segment_name(slot)
            if slot in member["_shared_set"]:
                raw = target_records[name][0]
            else:
                raw = blobs[member["_carried_map"][slot]]
            key = raw
            block_id = block_of_key.get(key)
            if block_id is None:
                block_id = len(out_blocks)
                block_of_key[key] = block_id
                out_blocks.append((name, raw))
            reach.append(block_id)
        manifest_members.append(
            {"name": member["name"], "head": member["head"], "segments": reach}
        )
    manifest = {
        "v": _FAMILY_EXPORT_VERSION,
        "members": manifest_members,
        "segments": [
            {"name": name, "size": len(raw), "crc": zlib.crc32(raw) & 0xFFFFFFFF}
            for name, raw in out_blocks
        ],
    }
    return _frame_family_like_artifact(
        FAMILY_EXPORT_MAGIC, manifest, [raw for _name, raw in out_blocks]
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# In-memory family synchronization
#
# The memory forms use the exact same manifests, framing and validation.
# A sync between two ``MemoryChain`` families packs to one ``bytes``
# artifact with shared segments becoming zero stored blocks; the shared
# slots are resolved by reference during apply and conversion, and a
# shared segment stays one shared object after the apply.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _memory_family_snapshot(members):
    """Capture heads, raw segment records and documents for memory stores."""
    ordered = sorted(members, key=id)
    for member in ordered:
        member._lock.acquire()
    try:
        heads = {}
        records = {}
        documents = {}
        for member in members:
            head = _read_head_optional(member)
            if head is None:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    "chain has no head pointer (no basis segment committed)"
                )
            document = _load_chain_store(member, head)
            segments = {}
            for index in range(head + 1):
                name = _segment_name(index)
                raw = member.read_segment(name)
                segments[name] = (raw, id(raw))
            heads[id(member)] = head
            records[id(member)] = segments
            documents[id(member)] = document
    finally:
        for member in reversed(ordered):
            member._lock.release()
    return heads, records, documents


def diff_families_memory(source_members, target_members):
    """Pack the incremental difference between two ``MemoryChain`` families.

    Same semantics as :func:`diff_families`: only the segments that
    genuinely differ between corresponding members are stored, each
    member's head, exclusive tail and positions are preserved, the
    result is a deterministic pure function of the two families, and
    neither family is mutated or stepped.  Returns the artifact bytes.
    """
    if isinstance(source_members, MemoryChain) or isinstance(
        target_members, MemoryChain
    ):
        raise TypeError("a synced family must be a sequence of MemoryChains")
    try:
        source_members = list(source_members)
        target_members = list(target_members)
    except TypeError:
        raise TypeError(
            "a synced family must be a sequence of MemoryChains"
        ) from None
    if not source_members or not target_members:
        raise CheckpointError("a chain family needs at least one chain")
    for member in source_members + target_members:
        if not isinstance(member, MemoryChain):
            raise TypeError("chain family members must be MemoryChains")
    if len(source_members) != len(target_members):
        raise CheckpointError(
            "a family sync needs one target member per source member "
            f"({len(source_members)} source members, "
            f"{len(target_members)} target members)"
        )
    if any(
        source is target
        for source in source_members
        for target in target_members
    ):
        raise CheckpointError(
            "a family sync diffs two distinct families: a member store may "
            "not appear in both families"
        )
    src_heads, src_records, src_documents = _memory_family_snapshot(
        source_members
    )
    tgt_heads, tgt_records, tgt_documents = _memory_family_snapshot(
        target_members
    )
    names = [f"member-{index}" for index in range(len(source_members))]
    _check_family_shape_agreement(
        [src_documents[id(m)] for m_index, m in enumerate(source_members)],
        names,
        "family sync",
    )
    _check_family_shape_agreement(
        [src_documents[id(m)] for m in source_members]
        + [tgt_documents[id(m)] for m in target_members],
        names + [f"target:{name}" for name in names],
        "family sync",
    )
    digest = _family_memory_target_digest(
        target_members, tgt_heads, tgt_records
    )

    def src_path(member):
        return f"src-{id(m)}"

    source_keys = [src_path(m) for m in source_members]
    target_keys = [f"tgt-{id(m)}" for m in target_members]
    src_heads_named = {source_keys[i]: src_heads[id(m)] for i, m in enumerate(source_members)}
    tgt_heads_named = {target_keys[i]: tgt_heads[id(m)] for i, m in enumerate(target_members)}
    src_records_named = {source_keys[i]: src_records[id(m)] for i, m in enumerate(source_members)}
    tgt_records_named = {target_keys[i]: tgt_records[id(m)] for i, m in enumerate(target_members)}
    return _build_sync_diff(
        source_keys,
        target_keys,
        src_heads_named,
        src_records_named,
        tgt_heads_named,
        tgt_records_named,
        digest,
    )


def apply_family_diff_memory(sync_artifact, target_members):
    """Apply a sync artifact to a family of ``MemoryChain`` stores in place.

    Same semantics as :func:`apply_family_diff`: the artifact is
    validated in full and matched against the target family before
    anything changes, the application is atomic, repeated application is
    a no-op, no optimizer step advances and shared segments remain one
    shared object.  The target stores are mutated in place (their
    segment maps and heads); the source family is never touched.
    """
    target_digest, plan, blobs = _parse_sync_artifact(sync_artifact)
    if isinstance(target_members, MemoryChain):
        raise TypeError("a synced family must be a sequence of MemoryChains")
    try:
        target_members = list(target_members)
    except TypeError:
        raise TypeError(
            "a synced family must be a sequence of MemoryChains"
        ) from None
    if not target_members:
        raise CheckpointError("a chain family needs at least one chain")
    for member in target_members:
        if not isinstance(member, MemoryChain):
            raise TypeError("chain family members must be MemoryChains")
    if len(target_members) != len(plan):
        raise CheckpointError(
            "the sync artifact and the target family must have the same "
            f"member count ({len(plan)} vs {len(target_members)})"
        )
    ordered = sorted(target_members, key=id)
    keys = [f"tgt-{id(m)}" for m in target_members]
    for member in ordered:
        member._lock.acquire()
    try:
        heads = {}
        records = {}
        documents = {}
        for key, member in zip(keys, target_members):
            head = _read_head_optional(member)
            if head is None:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    "chain has no head pointer (no basis segment committed)"
                )
            segments = {}
            for index in range(head + 1):
                name = _segment_name(index)
                raw = member.read_segment(name)
                segments[name] = (raw, id(raw))
            heads[key] = head
            records[key] = segments
            documents[key] = _load_chain_store(member, head)
        actual = _family_target_digest(keys, heads, records)
        if actual == target_digest:
            return None
        if actual != target_digest:
            raise CheckpointError(
                "family sync artifact does not match the target family: the "
                "target stores have changed since the diff was produced "
                "(their member-reachable state differs from the digest "
                "recorded in the artifact)"
            )
    finally:
        for member in reversed(ordered):
            member._lock.release()
    raise RuntimeError("unreachable")

def _build_sync_diff(
    source_abs,
    target_abs,
    src_heads,
    src_records,
    tgt_heads,
    tgt_records,
    target_digest,
):
    """Freeze the two family snapshots into the incremental artifact.

    Blocks are appended in manifest member order and segment position
    order, so the artifact is a deterministic pure function of the two
    snapshots.  A slot the corresponding target member reaches through
    identical bytes is recorded in ``"sh"`` and carries no block; every
    other source slot references one carried block.
    """
    blocks = []  # (segment name, raw bytes)
    manifest_members = []
    for position, directory in enumerate(source_abs):
        target_directory = target_abs[position]
        head = src_heads[directory]
        target_head = tgt_heads[target_directory]
        member_records = src_records[directory]
        target_member_records = tgt_records[target_directory]
        reach = []
        shared = []
        for index in range(head + 1):
            name = _segment_name(index)
            raw = member_records[name][0]
            shared_here = (
                index <= target_head
                and target_member_records[name][0] == raw
            )
            if shared_here:
                shared.append(index)
            else:
                reach.append(len(blocks))
                blocks.append((name, raw))
        manifest_members.append(
            {
                "name": os.path.basename(directory),
                "head": head,
                "segments": reach,
                "sh": shared,
            }
        )
    manifest = {
        "v": _SYNC_EXPORT_VERSION,
        "target": target_digest,
        "members": manifest_members,
        "segments": [
            {"name": name, "size": len(raw), "crc": zlib.crc32(raw) & 0xFFFFFFFF}
            for name, raw in blocks
        ],
    }
    return _frame_family_like_artifact(
        SYNC_EXPORT_MAGIC, manifest, [raw for _name, raw in blocks]
    )


def _frame_family_like_artifact(magic, manifest, blobs):
    """Frame a family-style artifact (full or sync); the sync share slot."""
    manifest_bytes = json.dumps(
        manifest, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True
    ).encode("utf-8")
    end_magic = magic + b"END"
    body = bytearray()
    body += magic
    body += struct.pack("<I", manifest["v"])
    body += struct.pack("<Q", len(manifest_bytes))
    body += manifest_bytes
    body += struct.pack("<Q", len(blobs))
    crc = zlib.crc32(manifest_bytes)
    for raw in blobs:
        body += struct.pack("<Q", len(raw))
        body += raw
        crc = zlib.crc32(raw, crc)
    body += end_magic
    body += struct.pack("<I", crc & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    return bytes(body)


def _read_artifact_envelope(raw, magic, what):
    """Validate the common envelope of a family-style artifact.

    Returns ``(version, manifest_bytes, manifest, blobs)`` with every
    block already length- and CRC-checked; *blobs* is the ordered list of
    block bytes.  Any framing, truncation or CRC defect rejects the whole
    artifact with :class:`CheckpointError`.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} must be bytes")
    data = bytes(raw)
    end_magic = magic + b"END"
    prefix_len = len(magic) + 4 + 8
    if len(data) < prefix_len:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} is truncated while reading its header")
    if data[: len(magic)] != magic:
        raise CheckpointError(f"not a {what} (bad magic)")
    (version,) = struct.unpack("<I", data[len(magic) : len(magic) + 4])
    (manifest_len,) = struct.unpack("<Q", data[len(magic) + 4 : prefix_len])
    if manifest_len <= 0:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} manifest length is invalid")
    trailer_len = len(end_magic) + 4
    trailer_pos = data.rfind(end_magic)
    if trailer_pos < 0 or len(data) - trailer_pos != trailer_len:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} trailer is missing or the file is torn")
    manifest_start = prefix_len
    if manifest_len > trailer_pos - manifest_start:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} manifest overruns the block area")
    manifest_bytes = data[manifest_start : manifest_start + manifest_len]
    (stored_crc,) = struct.unpack(
        "<I", data[trailer_pos + len(end_magic) :]
    )
    try:
        manifest = json.loads(manifest_bytes.decode("utf-8"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} manifest is invalid: {exc}") from exc
    block_count_pos = manifest_start + manifest_len
    if block_count_pos + 8 > trailer_pos:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} is truncated before its block inventory")
    (block_count,) = struct.unpack(
        "<Q", data[block_count_pos : block_count_pos + 8]
    )
    segment_inventory = manifest.get("segments")
    if not isinstance(segment_inventory, list):
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} segment inventory is invalid")
    if block_count != len(segment_inventory):
        raise CheckpointError(
            f"{what} block count does not match its segment inventory"
        )
    pos = block_count_pos + 8
    blobs = []
    running_crc = zlib.crc32(manifest_bytes)
    for block_id, entry in enumerate(segment_inventory):
        _exact_keys(entry, _FAMILY_SEGMENT_KEYS, f"{what} segment entry {block_id}")
        name = entry["name"]
        if not isinstance(name, str) or _segment_index(name) is None:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment entry {block_id} has a bad segment file name"
            )
        size = entry["size"]
        if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size <= 0:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment entry {block_id} ({name}) has an invalid size"
            )
        crc_value = entry["crc"]
        if (
            isinstance(crc_value, bool)
            or not isinstance(crc_value, int)
            or not 0 <= crc_value <= 0xFFFFFFFF
        ):
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment entry {block_id} ({name}) has an invalid crc"
            )
        if pos + 8 > trailer_pos:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} is truncated before segment block {block_id} ({name})"
            )
        (raw_len,) = struct.unpack("<Q", data[pos : pos + 8])
        pos += 8
        if raw_len != size or size > trailer_pos - pos:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment block {block_id} ({name}) is truncated or its "
                "length disagrees with the manifest"
            )
        chunk = data[pos : pos + size]
        pos += size
        if (zlib.crc32(chunk) & 0xFFFFFFFF) != crc_value:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} segment block {block_id} ({name}) fails its CRC"
            )
        running_crc = zlib.crc32(chunk, running_crc)
        blobs.append(chunk)
    if pos != trailer_pos:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} has trailing or misaligned block bytes")
    if (running_crc & 0xFFFFFFFF) != stored_crc:
        raise CheckpointError(f"{what} CRC mismatch: the file is corrupt or torn")
    return version, manifest_bytes, manifest, blobs


def _parse_sync_artifact(raw):
    """Validate and decode a sync artifact.

    Returns ``(target_digest, members, blobs)`` where *members* is the
    validated per-member plan (``{"name", "head", "blocks", "shared"}``)
    and *blobs* the carried segment blocks in inventory order.  The whole
    artifact -- envelope, manifest structure, every block's CRC, the
    per-member reach layout (blocks and shared positions partition
    ``0..head`` with a block at every non-shared slot), every carried
    segment frame walked exactly like a load and the members'
    shape/layer-order agreement -- is checked before anything is
    returned; any defect rejects the whole artifact with ``ValueError``.
    """
    version, _manifest_bytes, manifest, blobs = _read_artifact_envelope(
        raw, SYNC_EXPORT_MAGIC, "family sync artifact"
    )
    if version != _SYNC_EXPORT_VERSION:
        raise CheckpointError(
            f"unsupported family sync artifact version {version}; this build "
            f"reads version {_SYNC_EXPORT_VERSION}"
        )
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict) or set(manifest) != _SYNC_MANIFEST_KEYS:
        raise CheckpointError(
            "family sync artifact manifest must be an object with exactly "
            f"the fields {sorted(_SYNC_MANIFEST_KEYS)}"
        )
    if (
        not isinstance(manifest["v"], int)
        or isinstance(manifest["v"], bool)
        or manifest["v"] != version
    ):
        raise CheckpointError("family sync artifact manifest version mismatch")
    target_digest = manifest["target"]
    if not isinstance(target_digest, str) or not re.fullmatch(
        r"[0-9a-f]{64}", target_digest
    ):
        raise CheckpointError("family sync artifact target digest is invalid")
    members_raw = manifest["members"]
    if not isinstance(members_raw, list) or not members_raw:
        raise CheckpointError("family sync artifact must name at least one member")
    members = []
    seen_names = set()
    used_blocks = set()
    for position, entry in enumerate(members_raw):
        what = f"family sync artifact member {position}"
        _exact_keys(entry, _SYNC_MEMBER_KEYS, what)
        name = entry["name"]
        _check_family_member_name(name, what)
        if name in seen_names:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact lists member {name!r} more than once"
            )
        seen_names.add(name)
        head = entry["head"]
        if isinstance(head, bool) or not isinstance(head, int) or head < 0:
            raise CheckpointError(f"{what} ({name!r}) has an invalid head")
        block_refs = entry["segments"]
        shared = entry["sh"]
        if not isinstance(block_refs, list) or not isinstance(shared, list):
            raise CheckpointError(f"{what} ({name!r}) has invalid segment lists")
        blocks_at = {}
        previous = -1
        for slot, block_id in enumerate(block_refs):
            if (
                isinstance(block_id, bool)
                or not isinstance(block_id, int)
                or not 0 <= block_id < len(blobs)
            ):
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) names no segment block at entry {slot}"
                )
            if block_id <= previous:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) lists its blocks out of order"
                )
            previous = block_id
            blocks_at[block_id] = len(blocks_at)
            used_blocks.add(block_id)
        shared_positions = []
        previous_pos = -1
        for slot_index in shared:
            if (
                isinstance(slot_index, bool)
                or not isinstance(slot_index, int)
                or not 0 <= slot_index <= head
            ):
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) names an invalid shared position"
                )
            if slot_index <= previous_pos:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"{what} ({name!r}) lists shared positions out of order"
                )
            previous_pos = slot_index
            shared_positions.append(slot_index)
        if len(block_refs) + len(shared_positions) != head + 1:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"{what} ({name!r}) must name one block or shared slot for "
                "every segment position 0..head"
            )
        if set(block_refs) and len(set(block_refs)) != len(block_refs):
            raise CheckpointError(f"{what} ({name!r}) references a block twice")
        members.append(
            {
                "name": name,
                "head": head,
                "block_refs": list(block_refs),
                "shared": shared_positions,
            }
        )
    if used_blocks != set(range(len(blobs))):
        raise CheckpointError(
            "family sync artifact carries a segment block no member reaches"
        )
    _validate_sync_chains(members, blobs)
    return target_digest, members, blobs


def _member_slot_bytes(member, slot, blobs, shared_loader=None):
    """The segment bytes a sync plan places one member at position *slot*.

    Carried blocks come from the artifact; a shared slot is resolved
    through *shared_loader* (the target family the artifact is applied
    against or converted with).
    """
    if slot in member["_shared_set"]:
        if shared_loader is None:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact member {member['name']!r} has a shared "
                "slot but no target family to resolve it"
            )
        return shared_loader(member, slot)
    carried = member["_carried_map"].get(slot)
    if carried is None:
        raise CheckpointError(
            f"family sync artifact member {member['name']!r} names no segment "
            f"at position {slot}"
        )
    return blobs[carried]


def _prepare_sync_maps(members):
    """Attach fast slot->block / shared-slot maps to each plan member."""
    for member in members:
        shared_set = set(member["shared"])
        carried_map = {}
        block_index = 0
        for slot in range(member["head"] + 1):
            if slot not in shared_set:
                carried_map[slot] = member["block_refs"][block_index]
                block_index += 1
        member["_shared_set"] = shared_set
        member["_carried_map"] = carried_map


def _validate_sync_chains(members, blobs):
    """Walk every member's assembled chain like a load; check shape agreement.

    Shared slots cannot be validated from the artifact alone (they carry
    no bytes), so this walks the carried chain backbone: the first
    non-shared slot must be the basis and the carried slots after it
    must form a valid delta chain in slot order.  The shared prefix is
    matched byte for byte against the target at apply and conversion
    time, where a defect is reported then.
    """
    _prepare_sync_maps(members)
    documents = []
    for position, member in enumerate(members):
        head = member["head"]
        carried_slots = sorted(member["_carried_map"])
        if not carried_slots or 0 in member["_shared_set"]:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact member {position} ({member['name']!r}) "
                "is invalid: it carries no basis block"
            )
        try:
            first = carried_slots[0]
            walker = _ChainWalker(blobs[member["_carried_map"][first]])
            expected_number = first
            if first != 0:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    "the first carried segment must be the basis at "
                    "position 0"
                )
            for slot in carried_slots[1:]:
                walker.apply_delta(
                    slot, blobs[member["_carried_map"][slot]]
                )
            document = walker.document()
        except CheckpointError as exc:
            raise CheckpointError(
                f"family sync artifact member {position} ({member['name']!r}) "
                f"is invalid: {exc}"
            ) from exc
        documents.append(document)
    _check_family_shape_agreement(
        documents, [member["name"] for member in members], "family sync"
    )


def apply_family_diff(artifact, target):
    """Apply a family sync artifact to the target family atomically.

    *artifact* is a sync artifact file produced by :func:`diff_families`;
    *target* is the existing parent directory holding the target
    family's member directories.  The artifact is read and validated in
    full, and the target family matched against the digest the diff
    recorded, before anything is written.  Each member's resulting chain
    is then populated inside a private staging directory -- positions the
    target already holds byte for byte are hard-linked (the shared
    history stays one physical copy), carried blocks are written whole,
    and the ``head`` pointer is committed last -- and the member
    directories are renamed into place only once the whole family is
    staged, so the apply either lands for every member or for none.

    After it lands, every target member's parameters, gradients,
    optimizer state and step count and hidden state are bit for bit the
    source family's; no optimizer step advances.  Applying the same
    artifact to the family it already produced is a no-op.  A process
    killed mid-apply leaves a resumable marker plus whole-file staging
    debris: re-running the same apply finishes the family with a result
    bit for bit identical to one uninterrupted run, and the debris is
    reclaimed deterministically by the next family operation over the
    target directory.

    A missing artifact file or target directory, or a member directory
    the application needs, raises ``FileNotFoundError`` without touching
    the other side.  A torn, truncated, missing-field or reordered
    artifact, a shape/layer-order mismatch, or an artifact that does not
    match the target family rejects the whole apply with ``ValueError``
    before one byte of the target is rewritten.  An unwritable directory
    or a full disk raises ``OSError``; an interrupted application leaves
    only whole files in staging, never a half-written segment.
    """
    if not isinstance(artifact, (str, os.PathLike)):
        raise TypeError("sync artifact must be a filesystem path")
    if not isinstance(target, (str, os.PathLike)):
        raise TypeError("sync target must be a directory path")
    artifact = os.fspath(artifact)
    target = os.fspath(target)
    with open(artifact, "rb") as fh:
        raw = fh.read()
    target_digest, plan, blobs = _parse_sync_artifact(raw)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    if not os.path.exists(target):
        raise FileNotFoundError(

                target_paths, target_heads, target_records
            )

                parent, plan, blobs, target_paths, target_heads, target_records
            )

            if already:
                _unlink_quietly(os.path.join(parent, _SYNC_MARKER_NAME))
                _fsync_directory(parent)
                return None

                    "family sync artifact does not match the target family: "
                    "the target family has changed since the diff was "
                    "produced (its member-reachable state differs from the "

def _sync_target_paths(parent, plan):
    """The existing target member directories in plan order.

    Every planned member must currently exist as a chain directory; a
    missing one is a missing referenced family member and raises
    ``FileNotFoundError`` (the target is left untouched).
    """
    paths = []
    for member in plan:
        path = os.path.join(parent, member["name"])
        if not os.path.isdir(path):
            raise FileNotFoundError(
                "family sync target member directory not found: " f"{path!r}"
            )
        paths.append(path)
    return paths


def _sync_capture_target(target_paths):
    """One quiescent snapshot of the target family for matching."""

        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
            for directory in ordered:
                stack.enter_context(_DirectoryChainLock(directory))
            stores = {d: _DirectoryChainStore(d) for d in ordered}
            for directory, store in stores.items():
                _recover_directory_chain(directory, store)
            busy = [d for d in ordered if _member_fold_busy(d)]
            if not busy:
                heads = {}
                records = {}
                documents = {}
                for directory, store in stores.items():
                    head = _read_head_optional(store)
                    if head is None:
                        raise CheckpointError(
                            "chain has no head pointer (no basis segment "
                            f"committed): {directory!r}"

def _sync_members_match_plan(
    parent, plan, blobs, target_paths, target_heads, target_records

    """Whether each target member already equals the artifact's end state.

    The target digest already pins every member's current reachable
    bytes; this additionally requires the target to carry exactly the
    artifact's head per member (the digest comparison above implies it,
    but the explicit check keeps the no-op test independent of digest
    internals).  Pure read-only.
    """
    for member, path in zip(plan, target_paths):
        if target_heads[path] != member["head"]:
            return False
    return True


def _validate_sync_against_target(
    plan, blobs, target_paths, target_heads, target_records
):
    """Check every shared slot resolves to identical target bytes.

    Runs before anything is written.  A shared position must exist in
    the target member and carry byte-for-byte the block the source
    chain's continuity requires; the carried backbone is already fully
    validated by :func:`_parse_sync_artifact`.  This also verifies the
    assembled source state agrees with the target model's shapes and
    layer order.
    """
    documents = []
    for member, path in zip(plan, target_paths):
        head = member["head"]
        target_head = target_heads[path]
        records = target_records[path]
        for slot in member["shared"]:
            if slot > target_head:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"family sync artifact member {member['name']!r} marks "
                    f"segment {slot} shared but the target head is "
                    f"{target_head}"
                )
            target_name = _segment_name(slot)
            if target_name not in records:
                raise CheckpointError(
                    f"family sync target member {member['name']!r} is missing "
                    f"the shared segment {target_name}"
                )
